prose: ServeTheHome's perspective on where AMD's next-generation EPYC 9006 CPUs fit in the era of agentic AI. The author argues AMD's server-CPU strategy is becoming more expansive, building on a Substack piece on the EPYC 9006 'Venice' chips from the previous week. Based on the opening of the article.
highlights: Looks past Venice to the next EPYC generation
Argues AMD's server CPU strategy is widening
Frames CPUs in the context of agentic AI
